validation_notes: Price fell sharply from ~0.0485 to ~0.0425 in late July, then has been trading in a fairly flat, choppy range between roughly 0.0410-0.0440 since Jul 29, with no clear narrowing of highs and lows into an apex. There's no consistent descending upper trendline (highs bounce around 0.0425-0.0440 without a clean lower-high sequence) and the lower boundary is also roughly flat rather than rising. This looks more like a horizontal consolidation/range than a converging descending triangle. The algorithm likely mistook the flat range and a couple of lower highs for a descending triangle, but the touches are not clean enough (highs are inconsistent, no real convergence toward an apex) to call this a credible triangle setup.
